title: Plane Seat Simulator
description: Tour a complete single-aisle aircraft cabin, inspect seats and facilities, jump through an interactive seat map, and preview day, sunset, and night lighting.

prompt.objective: Build a clear 3D aircraft-cabin visualizer that lets travelers understand a seat before flying.

mintAssets.brief: A coherent set of economy seats, cabin doors, lavatory pieces, galley units, overhead panels, and passenger luggage.

experience: Orbit through the cabin, click furnishings to frame them, and fit the whole aircraft on demand.
Open a live seat map, jump to individual seats, and switch the cabin between day, sunset, and night.
prompt.visualDirection: Bright airline cabin materials, compact aviation controls, warm amber highlights, and an information-dense seat map.

thumbnail.alt: A full 3D airliner cabin viewed down the aisle with an interactive seat map floating at the right.

social.title: Plane Seat Simulator
social.description: Walk a complete 3D aircraft cabin, inspect every zone, and jump to seats from an interactive cabin map.

image.alt: A full 3D airliner cabin viewed down the aisle with an interactive seat map floating at the right.
